verdict.rationale: RudderStack clearly supports building audiences and activating them to downstream ad/marketing tools (docs-6, docs-27, docs-38, docs-59, docs-72), which covers the core activation use case. However, the evidence never specifies sync cadence or confirms near-real-time entry/exit of audience membership — reverse ETL/warehouse-based audience syncs are typically documented as scheduled/batch rather than continuous, and no docs item states continuous or streaming audience membership updates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sync frequency/continuous audience refresh, evidence of real-time membership entry/exit (vs batch reverse ETL jobs), and independent/hands-on confirmation of activation latency.
